claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: GW-7647 is a potent and selective PPARα agonist with no intrinsic cytotoxic pharmacophore; at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to produce little or no cell killing, with any weak antiproliferative signal reflecting non-specific lipophilic/off-target effects rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
